facts.fact: Nyasa Times reports that MACRA, acting as the country's designated Data Protection Authority, convened a stakeholder consultation on draft data protection regulations in Lilongwe, with Daniel Chiwoni as its Head of Data Protection.

The Data Protection Authority held a stakeholder consultation on draft data protection regulations, proposing registration fees for significant data controllers and processors of K50,000 to K7 million by annual turnover, before the regulations are finalised.
